dateline: Washington / Brussels / Kyiv / Ankara / Baltic Sea — June 5, 2026
heroHeadline: EUCOM FORMALLY CONFIRMS NATO FORCE MODEL CUTS (JUNE 3): FIGHTERS -⅓, ZERO SUBS, DRONES HALVED; TRUMP CONFIRMED FOR ANKARA (JULY 7-8, 32 DAYS); RUTTE IN KYIV — FIRST NATO-UKRAINE COUNCIL ON UKRAINIAN SOIL; POLAND CONFIRMS NUCLEAR SHARING TALKS; BALTOPS 26 UNDERWAY
heroSubtitle: As of June 5, 2026, the NATO-US tensions tracker enters a 32-day countdown to the Ankara Leaders' Summit (July 7–8) with three decisive developments from June 3–5. US European Command (EUCOM) published its official 'US Rightsizes NATO Force Model Contributions' press release on June 3, formally confirming what Der Spiegel first disclosed on May 26: SACEUR General Grynkewich at SHAPE Mons confirmed fighters cut by one-third (149 to 99 aircraft), zero US submarines contributed to NATO, and armed drones halved (24 to 12) — framed as correcting 'an unhealthy co-dependence in the NATO Force Model on US forces.' European and Canadian allies have been directed to present gap-filling plans before Ankara. On the same day, Secretary of State Rubio confirmed Trump will attend Ankara — ending months of speculation — and NATO Secretary General Rutte made an unannounced visit to Kyiv where he chaired the first-ever NATO-Ukraine Council meeting held on Ukrainian soil, meeting FM Sybiha to coordinate the non-binding Ukraine pledge for Ankara. On June 4, Polish Defense Minister Kosiniak-Kamysz confirmed that the US is in active negotiations with multiple European countries — including Poland — on extending the NATO Nuclear Sharing programme, the first governmental acknowledgment from a prospective host nation following the FT/Defense News June 2 report. Turkey simultaneously deployed 40,000 security personnel and activated F-16 alert status for Ankara. NATO's BALTOPS 26 maritime exercise (June 4–19) has 15 nations and ~20 ships in the Baltic Sea — down ~50% from BALTOPS 25, directly reflecting the zero-submarine US NATO commitment confirmed June 3. The NATO Defense Ministers meeting on June 18 in Brussels is the final pre-Ankara ministerial, where SACEUR's gap-filling demand will be central.
